mapper.select: SELECT m.MOVE_NO, m.WH_CD, m.ITEM_CD, m.FROM_LOC_CD, m.TO_LOC_CD, m.MOVE_QTY, i.ITEM_NM, w.WH_NM FROM STOCK_MOVE_HIST m JOIN ITEM_MST i ON m.ITEM_CD = i.ITEM_CD JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON m.WH_CD = w.WH_CD ORDER BY m.MOVE_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STOCK_MOVE_HIST (MOVE_NO, WH_CD, ITEM_CD, FROM_LOC_CD, TO_LOC_CD, MOVE_QTY) VALUES (#{moveNo}, #{whCd}, #{itemCd}, #{fromLocCd}, #{toLocCd}, #{moveQty})
